title: Car Line Tycoon mod manifest (mod.json)
description: The manifest of a mod folder. The folder's name must be the mod's id.

format.description: The kind of file. Always this value.

formatVersion.description: The version of the format. The game reads version 1 and refuses a newer one.

gameVersion.description: The oldest game version the mod needs, as "0.6.0" or ">=0.6.0". A newer version than the game's turns the mod off with a warning.

id.description: The mod's id: the same text as the folder's name.

version.description: The mod's own version, shown on the Mods page.

name.description: The mod's name per language, by two-letter code ("en", "it", ...). English is the fallback.

description.description: The mod's description per language, by two-letter code.

authors.description: The authors, shown on the Mods page.

type.description: What the mod holds. A mod of one type reads only files of that type; a pack reads all five.
